guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice has the dominant anomalies: latency-90 up 1850% (z=+370) and latency-50 up ~997%, while its socket count fell 57.6% and memory fell 48.5%, with workload down 89%. Checkoutservice logs show 124 'failed to send order confirmation' errors with 'no healthy upstream' and connection resets, which points to emailservice being unreachable, and its own logs show AttributeError on 'Check' (health check failing).

proposed_fix.description: Restart/redeploy the emailservice pods and fix the gRPC health check handler (missing 'Check' method) so the mesh sees them as healthy; verify the socket/connection state afterward.
